verdict_vs_current.quote: Google is now approximately: - $328,000 ahead over four years - $82,000 per year ahead on average - 15.6% above your current compensation

recommendation.quote: If the Google role and manager are at least comparable to your current situation, accept. The revised package clears a reasonable financial threshold for switching.

refresh_valued_at.quote: Ignoring raises, stock-price changes, refresh grants, and promotions at both companies

level_claim.quote: That is a reasonable switching premium for a lateral move.

walkaway_tied_to.quote: If the Google job itself appears meaningfully worse, stay at Meta—the offer is good, but it is not large enough to compensate for a role you expect to dislike.

final_decision.quote: My call: lean accept, assuming you like the role, manager, and scope

ask_focus.quote: I would not make another compensation counter after they have labeled this their best offer.
